description: CRH public limited company is the leading provider of building materials critical to modernizing infrastructure, with a team of 83,032 people across 3,961 locations whose unmatched scale, connected portfolio and deep local relationships make it the partner of choice for transportation, water and reindustrialization projects. It holds market leadership positions in North America, Europe and Australia, has grown rapidly since its formation in 1970, and in 2025 generated $37.4 billion of total revenues, $3.8 billion of net income and $7.7 billion of adjusted EBITDA, with 40 percent of total revenues from infrastructure, 32 percent from residential construction and 28 percent from non-residential construction, and 60 percent of total revenues from sales to new-build construction and 40 percent from repair and remodel activity. Its connected portfolio supplies building materials across the construction value chain, and its Americas Division comprises two segments, Americas Materials Solutions and Americas Building Solutions.
